propositions: Every Reconcile Bridge pass re-attempts inbound (Jira → rebar) link writes that cannot succeed (source closed, redundant ancestor-descendant, or would create cycle), each failing identically and logging WARNING, with no durable record preventing re-emission

The applier catches all link write exceptions, logs a warning, and continues with no memory of the failure, so the identical impossible set is re-derived and re-attempted every pass (~5–6 min), generating 200+ doomed writes per hour

The fix introduces a durable impossible_links.json store with deciding digests keyed on structural inputs (endpoint status, parent chain, deps) that the three validators actually read, so matching records skip the write but invalidate when structure changes

The endpoint digest covers every ticket on the parent chain to account for resolve_hierarchy_link promotion; cycle records key on the global projection to catch transitive graph changes at intermediate tickets

impossible_links.json must be committed to the tickets branch by _commit_binding_store_snapshot and its idempotency set, otherwise records are lost between CI passes and the fix has no effect in production

Classify maps link exceptions to closed_source, redundant_ancestry, or cycle for durable recording; unrecognised exceptions return None and skip recording, so transient faults never become permanent suppressions
